transcript.text: my samsung washer dryer is making evrything smell damp/musty even after its washed, its gross. wot do i do

That musty smell is usually caused by moisture trapped in the drum or filters because the drying cycle isn't removing it effectively. The most common culprits are a blocked pump filter or condenser, which stops air from circulating properly, or simply overloading the machine for drying (a washer-dryer can only dry about half the load it washes). To fix this safely: unplug the machine, place towels under the bottom front filter to catch water, and clean out any fluff/debris. If your model has a condenser unit near there, remove and rinse it under cold water until clear. Let me know if you've done these checks and whether the load was within the dry capacity.
ok i can try the filter at the bottom. the smell is more from the drum and the drawer tho, not the drying as such. what do you mean by condenser, i dont think mine has one i can see?

A condenser is a specific part found on some washer-dryers (usually older or larger models) that cools steam into water using cold tap water; most modern Samsung washer-dryers are 'condensing' units without a separate removable condenser block, so you likely don't have one. Since the smell is coming from the drum and drawer rather than just wet clothes, it’s often caused by trapped lint or stagnant water in hidden spots. The pump filter at the bottom catches fluff but can also trap small items and sludge that smells when damp.
ok so what should i do about the smell in the drum and drawer then?

Since the smell is coming from the drawer and drum, the most likely cause is stagnant water or mould buildup in those specific areas rather than a mechanical fault with the drying process. The detergent drawer often traps old liquid and fabric softener which turns into black mould if not removed regularly. Please unplug the machine, pull out the detergent drawer completely and wash it in hot soapy water (check for black mould spots), then wipe the empty slot clean. Also check the rubber door seal for trapped debris or black mould patches. Did you find any mould or sludge in either place?
ok i had a look. the drawer has slimy black stuff in the softener bit and the slot, and the door seal has black spots and grey sludge in the bottom fold. gross. how do i get rid of it?

That slimy black stuff is mould and biofilm, which is exactly what causes the musty smell. To get rid of it: remove the detergent drawer completely (press the blue release tab if there is one) and soak all parts in hot water with a little bleach or washing-machine cleaner for 15 minutes; scrub the slot inside the machine with an old toothbrush to remove the residue from the folds. For the door seal, wipe the grey sludge out of the bottom fold using a cloth soaked in hot soapy water or a diluted bleach solution (wear gloves), then dry it thoroughly. Finally, run an empty maintenance cycle at 90°C with a washing-machine cleaner or two cups of white vinegar to kill any remaining bacteria in the drum and pipes.
